Hi Lina — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the COI and W-9. A few clarifications from Finance and Procurement to avoid follow-up loops: 

1) Additional Insured wording (sample we can accept):
"Redwood Inference, Inc., its directors, officers, employees, and agents are included as Additional Insureds with respect to liability arising out of the operations of the Named Insured. Coverage afforded to the Additional Insureds shall be primary and non-contributory as to any other insurance available to Redwood Inference, Inc., and such coverage shall not be canceled or reduced without thirty (30) days’ prior written notice to Redwood Inference, Inc."

2) Waiver of Subrogation: preferred on Workers' Compensation (if permitted by state law).

3) Aggregate limits: $2,000,000 aggregate is acceptable for this engagement given scope, but we do require the per-occurrence limit to be $1,000,000. Please ensure the certificate reflects the per-occurrence and aggregate numbers clearly.

4) Please add the PO number (PO-76842) in the Certificate Description box on the COI so our system can index it.

5) For the SOC2 status, a current security summary and a link to your compliance program are sufficient for procurement to proceed; a full Type II report can be added to the vendor file when available.

Next steps: if your broker can issue the Additional Insured endorsement and Waiver of Subrogation with the sample wording above, please return the updated COI + endorsement PDF and we'll proceed to create the PO and finalize payment terms. Our AP team will confirm invoicing cadence once the vendor record is created.

Redwood HubSpot vendor record: https://redwood.hubspot.com/vendor/greenframe
